title: Hide retired items and list in next's order
lead:
`slicer list` hides done items, but a retired row is still in the default
queue, and the rows come back in stored order. `slicer next` already walks a
different sequence: unblocked started items by effective score, then unblocked
open items by effective score. The default list should be that sequence, then
the other rows that are still visible.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** changing `next`, `move`, `sort`, or the rendered roadmap. `--sort score` stays a flat effective-score sort. Parked and later items stay visible.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The list is how a person and an agent see the work ahead. A retired item is
finished in the same sense a done item is: it is not going to be implemented.
A stored-order list also hides the order `next` will actually offer. On this
repo S80 scores the same as S06 but depends on S06, so a flat score sort puts
it second while `next` will not return it until S06 is done.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/cli.py` — `cmd_list` and the `list` parser
- `README.md` — the `list` row
- `docs/agents.md` — the `list` payload row
- `docs/getting-started.md` — the sentence that treats an unsorted list as stored order
- `src/slicer/ai.py` — the `slicer list --json` instruction
- `CHANGELOG.md` — the unreleased list bullet
- `tests/test_cli.py`, `tests/test_scoring.py`, `tests/test_sort.py`

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
1. Default `list` omits retired as well as done. `--all` and `--status retired` include the retired item.
2. A started low-score item is listed before an open higher-score item, and that first id is what `next` returns.
3. A blocked open item with a higher score is listed after the unblocked open items.
4. `--sort score` still orders those same rows by effective score alone, blocked item included.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
When `--all` and `--status` are absent, drop `done_status` and, when it is non-empty, `retired_status`. Do not hardcode either word. `--status` replaces that default. `--all` turns it off. `--all` with `--status` stays a usage error.

Default order, after the status, tree, and pass filters, is three stable tiers. Ties keep stored order. Effective score is the same value `next` uses.

1. Unblocked started items, highest effective score first.
2. Unblocked open items, highest effective score first.
3. Every other visible item, highest effective score first.

The startable prefix is the sequence `next`, `next -n 1`, `next -n 2`, for items the filters still include. `--sort score` stays a flat effective-score sort with no tiers. Do not change `next`, `move`, `sort`, or the rendered roadmap.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: `slicer list` on this repo omits retired S03 and starts with S06, then the other unblocked open items by score, with blocked S80 after that run. `slicer next` is still S06. `slicer check` passes.
